title: Signals and Systems
description: Signals and Systems gives students the mathematical language for analyzing time-varying information and linear systems. It supports communications, controls, signal processing, circuits, and computer engineering applications.

topics.title: Continuous-Time Signals
topics.description: This section develops continuous-time signals through the concrete vocabulary, procedures, examples, and checks students need in Signals and Systems.

children.title: Specific Terms and Concepts
children.description: Learn the named vocabulary that makes continuous-time signals precise rather than just intuitive.

children.title: Procedures, Calculations, or Analytic Moves
children.description: Practice the concrete moves students should be able to perform when working with continuous-time signals.

children.title: Apply unit step in a worked example
Compare unit impulse with periodic signal
Common Cases, Pitfalls, and Checks
children.description: Use these details to recognize where continuous-time signals succeeds, where it can mislead, and what to check before trusting a result.

children.title: Watch for misuse of convolution integral
Explain how unit step changes the interpretation
